vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: presale-one-pass-orchestrator
Version: 0.1.0

The skill bundle instructs the AI agent to "Run the mapped check command from verification matrix" in `references/qa-defect-loop.md`. This creates a significant command injection or Remote Code Execution (RCE) vulnerability, as the agent is directed to execute commands from an external, unspecified source without explicit sanitization. Additionally, the agent is instructed to "fix implementation" and dynamically select "fallback test runners," indicating broad execution and modification capabilities that, while potentially functional, pose a high risk if the agent's inputs or environment are compromised.
